title: Rethinking Giftedness in the Age of Generative AI: A Relational Epistemic Agency Model for Advanced Learners
why: Proposes a relational model of epistemic agency for advanced learners, which gives your AI-and-professional-criticality papers a frame for the problem that performance stops being evidence of independent competence once GenAI is in the loop.
caveat: A theoretical synthesis from a structured database search. The model is not tested with students.
